query: Build a two-input CMOS NOR gate (two p-MOS in series to VDD, two n-MOS in parallel to ground) in Multisim, with input switches and a multimeter on the output, and show me its truth table.
expected_behavior: Uses NMOS/PMOS with the substrate pins tied as in the rules (p-MOS substrate to VDD, n-MOS to ground) or the cmos_nor2 block
Inputs are switches S1/S2 to VCC/ground, the output is the multimeter XMM1
One common ground bus at the bottom; build() report: overlaps none, check: READY
The 5 V supply is stated as intended (the VCC warning is explained, not hidden)
The ngspice truth table says NOR and is shown to the user
